items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 11 at 7:31PM EDT until October 11 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
Small Craft Advisory issued October 11 at 2:33PM EDT until October 12 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 4 to 7 ft.

* WHERE...Southeast North Carolina coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 8 AM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
